applies_to: current frozen source; do not assert identical implementation for four early development TSVs

rules.execution_id: counter starts at 0 and increments before allocation
rules.evaluate: 64 iterations of x=(x*6364136223846793005+1) mod 2^64, starting at input
rules.dispatch: compute output and retain input Arc; advance clock 1 tick then ready_at=now+3
rules.validation: output.id==request.id and output.value==evaluate(input); advance clock 1 tick
rules.duplicate_attempt: after first input submit, submit same live ID/input, key=0, deadline=now+1000; require DuplicateRequest
rules.cancel: after pump when an execution exists, choose first retained RequestDispatched in that drain or ID1 if none; try until one successful cancel
rules.observation_overflow: drop oldest retained event; cancellation ID may therefore differ in saturated traces
rules.checksum: wrapping sum of successful receipt values only
rules.backup_and_output: each success advances clock 1 tick per stage
rules.termination: all receipts and executions drained, shutdown(now+10); final host/device/pinned reservations all zero
